In 2022, [[Simon]] appeared during the [[SkyBlock Anniversary|{{Pink|SkyBlock Anniversary}}]] near the {{zone|Colosseum}} to distribute '''Crab Hat of Celebration - 2022 Edition'''s, which were animated unlike their 2020 counterpart. === Game Message === {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition ! Happy Anniversary!}} |} == Usage == {{:Hatcessories/Effect}} Additionally, the '''Crab Hat of Celebration''' gives the following cosmetic effect when worn: * Rainbow potion particles appear around the player. * Fireworks occasionally launch from the player's head. * For the 2022 Edition, the texture is animated. See [[#Gallery|§ Gallery]] below. == Trivia == * The color of the hat was randomly selected when it was claimed, like the [[Century Cake]] or the expression of [[Sloth Hat of Celebration]]. * The party hats worn by the crabs were white in 2020 and black in 2022. * Players can only acquire a Crab Hat on one [[profile]]. * Black Crab Hats are generally worth more on the [[Auction House]] because they are more visually pleasing, and the name blends in with the background in the tooltip. * The Crab Hats, [[Sloth Hat of Celebration|Sloth Hats]], and the [[Pulse Ring]] are the only [[Accessory|Accessories]] that give {{stat|mf}} without [[Enrichments]]. * As a {{Special}} accessory, the Crab Hat can be [[Enrichments|enriched]]. * When the 2022 edition was released, the stats, enrichments, and [[Accessory Power]] of different editions stacked with each other. ** The stacking has been removed since a certain point before Aug 19, 2022. * The amount of {{stat|int}} gained depends only on the number of [[Time|SkyBlock years]] that have passed since the player created their oldest profile, regardless of the player's activity during this time. The current maximum, which applies to players who joined during the first SkyBlock year, is {{SkyClock}}. * The Crab Hat was the first {{Special}} accessory. * Hatccessories are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". == Gallery ==
